title: Less Data, Faster Convergence: Goal-Driven Data Optimization for Multimodal Instruction Tuning
abstract: arXiv:2603.12478v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Multimodal instruction tuning is often compute-inefficient because training budgets are spread across large mixed image-video pools whose utility is highly uneven. We present Goal-Driven Data Optimization (GDO), a framework that computes six sample descriptors for each candidate and constructs optimized 1$\times$ training subsets for different goals. Under a fixed one-epoch Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct training and evaluation recipe on 8 H20 GPUs, GDO uses far fewer training samples than the Uni-10x baseline while converging faster and achieving higher accuracy. Relative to the fixed 512k-sample Uni-10x baseline, GDO reaches the Uni-10x reference after 35.4k samples on MVBench, 26.6k on VideoMME, 27.3k on MLVU, and 34.7k on LVBench, while improving Accuracy by +1.38, +1.67, +3.08, and +0.84 percentage points, respectively. translated_title: 数据更少，收敛更快：面向多模态指令调优的目标驱动数据优化
translated_abstract: arXiv:2603.12478v3 公告类型：交叉替换 摘要：多模态指令调优通常在计算效率上不高，因为训练预算被分散在大量混合图像-视频池中，而这些数据的效用极不均匀。我们提出了目标驱动数据优化（GDO）框架，该框架为每个候选样本计算六个样本描述符，并为不同目标构建优化的1×训练子集。在固定的单轮Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct训练和评估流程下，使用8块H20 GPU，GDO使用的训练样本远少于Uni-10x基线，同时收敛更快且准确率更高。相对于固定的512k样本Uni-10x基线，GDO在MVBench上仅用35.4k样本、VideoMME上26.6k、MLVU上27.3k、LVBench上34.7k样本即达到Uni-10x参考水平，同时分别将准确率提升了+1.38、+1.67、+3.08和+0.84个百分点。增益在MVBench和MLVU上最大，而LVBench提升较为温和，这与其超长视频特性一致。
tldr: 该论文提出目标驱动数据优化（GDO）框架，通过六个样本描述符构建优化训练子集，在显著减少训练样本数量的同时，实现更快的收敛和更高的多模态任务准确率。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Goal-Driven Data Optimization (GDO), a framework that constructs optimized training subsets using six sample descriptors, achieving faster convergence and higher accuracy on multimodal tasks with significantly fewer training samples.
